name: TransitionLooper
description: DJ transition looper for NTS-3. Always captures a tempo-synced 16-step stereo loop plus wrap glue. Untouched = bypass. Hold the pad to fade from live input into the stored loop; release to fade back. X = fade time (1/32 to 2 bars), Y = pitch-preserving WSOLA stretch (0.5x–2x), Depth = wet. TYPE selects a DJ mix: volume blend, high-pass filter fade, low-pass fade, bass swap, echo out, brake, or loop roll.

params.name: TIME
params.detail: Fade in/out length, tempo-synced from a 1/32 note to 2 bars

params.name: STRCH
params.detail: WSOLA time stretch of the loop (0.5x–2x, center = 1.0, pitch held)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Loop wet level while the pad is held

params.name: TYPE
params.detail: Transition: VOL, HPF, LPF, BASS, ECHO, BRK, ROLL

params.name: SIZE
params.detail: Stretch grain length (short = tighter transients, long = smoother)

params.name: TONE
params.detail: How far filter and bass-swap sweeps travel
